name: ceus-media/rss
description: PHP library to create, read and combine RSS 2.0 and Atom feeds, with podcast (iTunes) support.

suggest.ext-curl: for reading feeds from URLs (UrlReader, Combiner::addUrl, Combiner::addUrls)

scripts-descriptions.dev:install: Installs project dependencies for Development stage quietly
scripts-descriptions.dev:update: Updates project dependencies for Development stage
scripts-descriptions.dev:rector: Shows suggestions of configured Rector rules
scripts-descriptions.dev:rector-fix: Apply currently configured Rector rules to codebase
scripts-descriptions.dev:stan-save: Store current results in ignore list
scripts-descriptions.dev:test-syntax: Validate code base syntax using PHP linter
scripts-descriptions.dev:test-coverage: Run unit tests with code coverage: summary on console, HTML report in doc/Test/Coverage, Clover XML in doc/Test (needs Xdebug or PCOV)
scripts-descriptions.dev:infection: Run mutation tests with Infection (needs Xdebug or PCOV), report in doc/Test/Infection
scripts-descriptions.dev:test-all: Run syntax check, coding style check, PHPStan and unit tests
scripts-descriptions.dev:demo: Start web server for demos on http://localhost:8080/
scripts-descriptions.dev:docs: Generate API reference and build documentation (MkDocs) into doc/Site/
scripts-descriptions.dev:docs-api: Generate API reference pages into doc/Manual/api/
scripts-descriptions.dev:docs-install: Install MkDocs Material into Python venv tool/docs/.venv (optional, else Docker is used)
scripts-descriptions.dev:docs-serve: Generate API reference and serve documentation on http://localhost:8000
scripts-descriptions.dev:create-docs: Create classic API documentation by DocCreator in doc/API
